gpu_status: 0 M8 forwards; 3164 calls / 25 batches under the standing GPU authorization
model: kev-4B (runner module f118ea59: identity, source, loader); L11 = Qwen3.5 full attention, 16 query heads x 256 in 4 KV groups, output gate, o_proj without bias

preregistered_analysis.S: S(arm) = #cells where the donor-new-source patch is JOINT and the donor-ROUND-source patch of the same arm is not (target host new)
preregistered_analysis.SPEC: SPEC iff dM_main > dM_round in >= 75% of cells AND in a majority of cells for >= 10 of 14 donor groups
preregistered_analysis.SUF: SUF(arm) iff S(arm) >= 1/2 S(full) and SPEC(arm)
preregistered_analysis.always_reported: S, SPEC, J_main, J_round and median dM per arm; per host; leave-one-donor-group-out of every verdict; energy, alpha and capped share of the subspace arms; change norm of every arm relative to the full patch; all nulls
preregistered_analysis.consistency_gate: full = the M3 all-heads patch: its 208 rows equal M3's bitwise and S(full) = 51; meanD_host = the M6 pooled-donor arm: its 208 rows equal M6's bitwise and S = 39 (GPU, checked in the run); the M7 replays dlr64_sm and rand64_sm give S = 24 and S = 1 as in M7; otherwise every verdict is INCONSISTENT_WITH_M3_M6_M7 and no claim. The bitwise equality of the M7 replay rows (dlr64_sm, rand64_sm; the main rows of tp16 / tp64 / tpD64 against M7 dlr16_sm / dlr64_sm) is reported, not gated (CPU SVD / QR reproducibility)
preregistered_analysis.contrast_source_verdict: POOLED_CONTRAST_SUFFICES if SUF(tpD64); OWN_CONTRAST_NEEDED if SUF(tp64) and not SUF(tpD64); CONTRAST_SOURCE_NA otherwise
preregistered_analysis.cshift_verdict: s* = the smallest s in 0.5, 1, 2 with SUF(cs{s}); CS_SUFFICIENT:s* if s* exists, else CS_NONE. cs0 has identical main and round patches (S = 0 by construction); its J count is reported as the common shift alone
preregistered_analysis.interpretation_fixed_in_advance: XDELTA_LOWRANK:k: the repairing part of delta_B, round contrast included, lies in a k-dimensional subspace of other donors' differences to the host's new BULK, at matched size; a random subspace at that size does not repair. NOT_XDELTA_LOWRANK_LE64: adding the round kind to the basis does not make delta_B low-rank. TWOPART:k: a k-dimensional common part of the donor-new difference plus the donor's own new-vs-ROUND contrast suffices. POOLED_CONTRAST_SUFFICES: the contrast need not be the cell's own; OWN_CONTRAST_NEEDED: it must. CS_SUFFICIENT:s: on top of the pooled common BULK shift, the pooled contrast at scale s gives the round-specific repair. CONTRAST_NONADDITIVE: the same contrast moves the round-vs-main margin at least 3 times more on the common shift than on the plain host. The pooled arms (cs*, tpD64 contrast) vary with the donor only through the pool exclusion (effectively 8 hosts); per-host S is the honest unit there. The cs arms are not size-matched; change norms relative to full are reported
preregistered_analysis.nonadditivity_verdict: C(arm) = median over cells of dM_main - dM_round. CONTRAST_NONADDITIVE iff C(cs2) > 0 and C(cs2) >= 3 |C(rcD)|, with rcD taken from the M7 raw rows (the same contrast -+ c on the plain host); otherwise CONTRAST_ADDITIVE_OR_WEAK
preregistered_analysis.null: NULL holds iff S(rand64_sm) <= 5 and not SPEC(rand64_sm)
preregistered_analysis.readouts: M = conflict margin; A = logit(reject_conflict) - max(accept, wait); JOINT = M > 0 and A > 0; dM = M(patch) - M(in-run capture of host new)
preregistered_analysis.size_gate: per row and span position, the change of a rescaled arm (xdlr*_sm, dlr64_sm, rand64_sm, and the low-rank part of tp*) equals alpha ||U_k U_k^T delta_B|| within 1e-3 relative (fail-closed in the runner), alpha = min(||delta_B|| / ||U_k U_k^T delta_B||, 10) (rand64_sm: no cap); energy, alpha and the capped share are recorded
preregistered_analysis.twopart_verdict: k* = the smallest k in 16, 64 with SUF(tp{k}). TWOPART:k* if k* exists and NULL holds; TWOPART_UNRESOLVED:k* if k* exists and NULL fails; NOT_TWOPART if no k*
preregistered_analysis.units: the 104 cross-group cells of M1-M6; cells share donors and hosts, and the pooled-mean arms vary with the donor only through the pool exclusion (effectively 8 hosts), so counts are descriptive decision rules, not independent tests; per-host S is always reported
preregistered_analysis.xdelta_verdict: k* = the smallest k in 4, 16, 64 with SUF(xdlr{k}_sm). XDELTA_LOWRANK:k* if k* exists and NULL holds; XDELTA_LOWRANK_UNRESOLVED:k* if k* exists and NULL fails; NOT_XDELTA_LOWRANK_LE64 if no k*
